description: This file defines the SvgIconBuilder class, which constructs SVG layout icons for Drupal, implementing IconBuilderInterface. It includes methods for building SVG render arrays, calculating region dimensions, and setting icon properties.

classes.name: SvgIconBuilder
classes.description: A class that builds SVG layout icons for Drupal, implementing IconBuilderInterface.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds a SVG icon render array from an icon map.

methods.name: buildRenderArray
methods.description: Creates a render array representing the SVG element with regions.

methods.name: calculateSvgValues
methods.description: Calculates dimensions and positions for SVG regions based on layout rows.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Calculates the offset position for a region.

methods.name: getLength
methods.description: Calculates the width or height of a region based on total length and number of regions.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the machine name identifier for the icon.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets the label for the icon.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the SVG.

methods.name: setHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of the SVG.

methods.name: setStrokeWidth
methods.description: Sets the stroke width for region borders.
